svg.title: A-05 · ai-automation: Support automation for a publisher. Classifies intent, runs hybrid semantic and keyword retrieval, and unifies one person's identity across WhatsApp, Instagram, email, web and SMS. Stack: Node.js, Express, LangChain, Weaviate, Supabase, Twilio.
